description: Version of the deterministic snapshot-bound identity-handoff contract.
Immutable BAdW source snapshot verified before this handoff was built.
Stable BAdW source witness occurrence identifier; it is not a canonical dictionary entry ID.
BAdW delivery type, for example database_article or generated_pdf_span.
confident_link, candidate_only, or unmatched; candidate evidence is never silently promoted.
Disposition preserved from the C6/C10 identity gate.
Exact confidence gate used only for a confident_link.
Provisional WtSOCR QA coordinate anchor only for a confident link.
BAdW witness with a retained possible local-anchor association.
Provisional local anchor in volume:page:line form.
confident_link only for the selected strict-gate edge; every other retained edge is candidate_only.
Exact historical Library of Congress (LoC) heading evidence; it is not Wylie.
Exact printed-page evidence when available from a generated PDF span.
Provisional local QA coordinate anchor; it is not a final canonical entry ID.
All source witnesses with a strict confident link to this anchor.
All non-selected source candidates retained for later resolution.
